stage.name: Laborratory
stage.type: Challenge stage (seventh challenge stage; unlocked with 33 Rosaries or via Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane spell 'divineassault'; hyper mode unlocked by default)
stage.spawn_type: Standard: enemies approach from all four sides of the player
stage.modifiers_note: Wiki infobox: hyper starting spawns 60, player/enemy speed x1.9, projectile speed x1.15, greed x1.7, luck x1.1. Not needed here. No per-minute scaling and no item-drop restriction on this stage (Silver Chests can drop from bosses before 10:00).
stage.enemy_cap_rule: Periodic spawning stops while 300 or more enemies are alive; only bosses and map-event enemies can still spawn (Map event page).
stage.spawn_rule: Each minute's wave has a minimum enemy count and a spawn interval. If alive count < minimum, spawn until the quota is filled; otherwise spawn one of each enemy type in the wave per interval. Bosses are teleported back onto screen rather than despawned.
stage.map_event_chance_rule: Event chance is divided by player Luck (chanceWithLuck = eventChance / totalLuck); evaluated per repeat; no chance or 0 means guaranteed.

stage_items.note: All obtained from lever flips; the hidden rings/metaglios need no Yellow Sign here.

stage.destructibles: Levers act as this stage's destructible-count props (max 12 near the railroad, up to 5 per room); see layout.special_mechanics.

layout.size_note: Not stated on the wiki. A compound of a large central room, a Danger room (west) and Electricity room (east) (mirrored when inverse), winding corridors, and a railroad with platform to the south. Treat as a mid-sized enclosed complex, exact size unknown.
layout.obstacles: Interior walls of rooms and winding corridors with openings between rooms; train tracks in the south. Dense wall geometry compared with open-field stages; exact layout unknown.
layout.theme: Abandoned alchemical workshop/foundry of Santa Ladonna: industrial lab rooms with danger and high-voltage warning signs on the walls, metal corridors, and a railroad platform with a train track south of the start (theme music 'Awe of the Unknown').
layout.special_mechanics: LEVERS: stage props that flip when the player walks over them. They spawn off-screen at fixed spots once every 20 s; each room holds at most 5 levers at once, the railroad area up to 12 (the stage destructible max). Spawn rate and how favourable the effect is scale with Luck; Mad Groove does not affect levers. Possible effects (exact weights unknown): CENTRAL ROOM (largest, nearest the start, north of start; south when inverse): weapon Santa Javelin / Arma Dio, OR Metaglio Left / Metaglio Right, OR a swarm of Yellow Reaper Trainees / Trinacria / self-destructing Fallen Cherubbello. DANGER ROOM (west of centre, danger signs; east when inverse): weapon Cross / King Bible, OR passive Clover / Spellbinder, OR a swarm of Jellyfish / Dust Elementals / Musc Muscs. ELECTRICITY ROOM (east of centre, high-voltage signs also on the corridor leading to it; west when inverse): weapon Santa Water, OR Attractorb / Silver Ring / Gold Ring, OR a swarm of Jellyfish / Dust Elementals / Musc Muscs. ANY ROOM: pickups Coin Bag, Vacuum, Rosary or Little Clover. RAILROAD (south: walkway below the rails and the platform by the corridors): levers summon the train 'Take Us Away' from the left, followed by alternating coal/tank cars; it deals 200 damage (scales with Might) to every enemy it hits. TRAP PIZZAS: circular floor plates inside rooms, in front of lever spawn points and in passages; stepping on one triggers a random one of 9 map events (3 Pile Assaults, 2 Jellyfish Walls, 2 RetroBot Swarms, a Musc Musc Swarm, a Jellyfish Swarm; see unsupported_events), 15 s minimum cooldown. Silver Chests can drop from bosses before 10:00. ER-2000 Gunner Arcana holders at 5:00 and 10:00. Reaper at 20:00.

swarm.shape: cluster of enemies crossing/attacking (fixed direction for the swarm variants)

jellyfish_wall.shape: ring of 40 jellyfish (default) closes in on and moves away from the player

pile_assault.shape: stationary shooters in an ellipsoid ring around the player that fire bullets

map_events.map_events_note: Event delay handling: with repeats, delay_s is the spacing between repeats; a delay without repeats is applied to 'at' as a start offset. Wiki Swarm 'Dust Elemental' assumed to be the fast fixed-direction variant (EX_MUD_FASTSWARM).

Take Us Away: a lever near the railroad (south) summons a steam-engine train from the left followed by alternating coal/tank cars; enemies it touches take 200 damage (scales with Might). Player-triggered, no fixed time.

unsupported_events.enemy: TRAINEE_Y / TRINACRIA / ANGEL2 (Central Room); JELLYFISH2_SWARM / MUD / ECTO2 (Danger and Electricity rooms)
unsupported_events.wiki_description: Lever outcomes that spawn enemy swarms (see stage.layout.special_mechanics). Player-triggered, no fixed time; Trainee/Trinacria/Cherubbello stats are in other stage files (cappella-magna).

unsupported_events_note: All timed wave-table events map to swarm / jellyfish_wall / pile_assault. Lever outcomes and trap pizza events are player-triggered with no fixed time, so they are listed here only.

waves.notes: Wiki lists 'Holy Circuit Creations (ConstableBot)' for the first swarm and 'Dust Elemental' for the second; the Dust Elemental variant is not named, EX_MUD_FASTSWARM assumed. Delay 15 s = repeat spacing (3 repeats).
Jellyfish Wall amount not in table; wiki default of 40 used.
Second Pile Assault delay 30 s applied as start offset (5:30). Pile Assault units are the ranged Gunner variants. ER-2000 Gunner is the Arcana holder.
Swarm delay 30 s applied as start offset (6:30). No duration given; gen default applies.
Second wall delay 2 s applied as start offset (7:02).
Swarm delay 30 s applied as start offset (8:30). Wiki 'Big Musc Musc' variant -> ECTO2.
Second RetroBot swarm delay 15 s applied as start offset (9:15).
Bounty Hunter Gunner has no separate ranged statbox; EX_BOUNTYHUNTER reused. Pile Assault interval 0.7 s. ER-2000 Gunner is the Arcana holder.
Boss is the 'Minotaur Champion' sprite; BOSS_MIGNO2_5 (Dairy Plant Minotaur Boss) reused.
Boss is the Giant Goat-Horned Shooter; BOSS_PILE3 reused.
Second/first wall delays 12 s and 14 s applied as start offsets (18:12, 18:14).
Wave pool is 'Solid Tri-Blunder' (EX_BOSSGYORUNTIN_SOLID; wiki gives HP x Level and boss stats).
20:00: all enemies on screen cleared and The Reaper spawns; another Reaper each minute after.

reaper.spawn: 20:00 (all on-screen enemies cleared), then one additional Reaper each minute afterwards
reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).

light_sources.spawn_location: predetermined possible spawn locations in this stage (Light source page); Mad Forest spawns them in an oval around the player
light_sources.cap_behaviour: when at cap, a new spawn appears nearest the player and the oldest despawns
light_sources.luck_note: Luck increases chance of pickups other than Gold Coin and Coin Bag.
light_sources.drops_note: Standard light source drops; on this stage the destructible-count props are levers (see layout.special_mechanics).

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: First-minute-of-stage values: '1:00 ... evo=1' etc. copied verbatim; a blank evo means not evolving.
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.
